title: Christmas tree with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='4' height='14' fill='#A0522D' rx='2'/>
  <!-- tree layers -->
  <polygon points='50,10 20,50 80,50' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <polygon points='50,10 20,50 35,50' fill='#3CB371'/>
  <polygon points='50,30 15,70 85,70' fill='#228B22'/>
  <polygon points='50,30 15,70 32,70' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 10,90 90,90' fill='#1E6B3A'/>
  <polygon points='50,50 10,90 30,90' fill='#228B22'/>
  <!-- star -->
  <polygon points='50,2 53,9 61,9 55,14 58,21 50,17 42,21 45,14 39,9 47,9' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='50,2 53,9 50,9' fill='#FFF176'/>
  <!-- ornaments -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FF4444'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FF4444'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='65' r='4' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='65' r='4' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='4' fill='#FF4444'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='80' r='3.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='82' r='4' fill='#111111'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='82' r='4' fill='#111111'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='81' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,88 Q50,94 58,88' stroke='#111111' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='87' r='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='87' r='3' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
